# ui::BackgroundHop

Header: `winui/ui/Coroutine.hpp`.

The awaitable [on_background()](namespace-ui.md#on_background) returns: submits the resumption to a scheduler. Only ever awaited, never named.

## BackgroundHop

```cpp
BackgroundHop(Scheduler& scheduler) noexcept
```

Resumes on one of `scheduler`'s workers.

## await_ready

```cpp
bool await_ready() const noexcept
```

Never ready: the coroutine always suspends.

## await_suspend

```cpp
void await_suspend(std::coroutine_handle<> coroutine) const
```

Hands `coroutine` over to be resumed there.

## await_resume

```cpp
void await_resume() const noexcept
```

Nothing to return.
